task.label: 재치 있는 20대(밝은 윗소리 + 거친 결 조금)
texts: 거짓말. 안 켜면 그냥 안경이잖아. 난 모리. 근거 없는 말은 안 믿어. 그래서, 나랑 무슨 상관인데? 흐음, 인정. 이번엔 네 말이 맞았어.
task.instruct: Street-smart young guy around twenty-two, quick-witted and cheeky. Light baritone that sits a little higher and brighter than average, with a slight raspy edge on stressed words. Fast relaxed pace, casual friendly sarcasm, half-smiling tone, crisp diction. Energetic but cool, sounds young and lively, not old or tired.
